Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention regarding your recent workplace behavior. It has come to our notice that there have been multiple complaints, and we want to ensure that our team environment remains respectful and aligned with our company values.

We value your contributions to the team and believe in addressing issues promptly and constructively. We expect an immediate improvement in your conduct to ensure it meets our professional standards. Please take this opportunity to reflect on the feedback and make the necessary adjustments.

If you have any questions or would like to discuss this further, please feel free to reach out to me or HR. We are here to support you in making these positive changes.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
